description: Massachusetts sources for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/data-policy.md, docs/registry/collection.md, and the review records in docs/registry/sources/.

sources.publisher: City of Boston Assessing Department (via Analyze Boston)
sources.license: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (ODC-PDDL), stated on the dataset page (license field 'odc-pddl', https://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/odc-pddl)
sources.ai_use: Not addressed by the publisher; PDDL places the data in the public domain without restriction
sources.redistribution: Permitted (PDDL); attribution: City of Boston Assessing Department, Analyze Boston
sources.notes: Dataset 'Property Assessment' (package e02c44d2-3c64-459c-8fe2-e1ce5f38a035) on the city's CKAN portal: one CSV per fiscal year (FY2004-FY2026) plus a data-key PDF and the occupancy-code PDF. FY2026 is 'fy2026-property-assessment-data_rev.csv' (about 80 MB, last modified 2026-05-22). Boston is one of four municipalities in Suffolk County (25025): Chelsea, Revere, and Winthrop assess separately and are not in this file. robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 10 for all agents (the collector honours it) and disallows /api/ and /datastore/, so the CKAN action API and the datastore are not used: the dataset HTML page is the landing page and the resource download URLs (allowed) are the files. The resource id in each download URL is stable; the file name changes with each fiscal-year release, so re-run discover for a new year.
